mapping_status: candidate exposure mapping; official questionnaire/codebook field identified; route, denominator and value review required
construct: lifetime or since prior interview, depending on source question and route
caveat: The unit is years and the item is conditional on the adult-education participation route; a 'None' response to the preceding BD007 multi-response item skips the duration follow-up, so a structural skip is not zero years. In 2018 BD008_W2_1 asks total years spent in adult education after the BD007_W2_1 attendance route, whereas BD008_W4_1 explicitly asks years since ZIWTime after BD007_W4_1. Keep these route/time windows separate and do not combine raw values without an explicit harmonization rule.
